method: DeSmuME 0.9.12 Python API with actual emulated buttons/touch. Screenshots manually reviewed. Native desktop control unavailable.

fixture.provenance: Actual fresh male game initialized through Oak intro and mother/Marill events, then saved in New Bark before entering Elm lab. No editor/state modifications. Trainer TDST.

verified: Imported genuine pre-acquisition battery save into variant and entered Elm lab.
Original greeting and Mr. Pokemon setup progressed into replacement three-starter gift, without starter selector.
Received message names Voltuff, Embernewt and Sedgling together.
Three nickname prompts appeared in the correct species order; all were declined.
Ordinary postgift dialogue completed and field/menu control resumed.
Party UI displayed exactly three distinct level 5 starters: Voltuff 21/21 HP, Embernewt 21/21 HP, Sedgling 19/19 HP.
Voltuff follower appeared while walking toward aide and during repeat Elm dialogue.
Actual game Save succeeded; separate emulator process imported resulting battery save and loaded the same three starters.
Re-interacting with Elm after reload produced ordinary Mr. Pokemon directions and did not duplicate any starter; party remained exactly three.

inputs.format: Commands run keys first, then touches, then frames. Key: [name,holdFrames,waitFrames]. Touch: [x,y,holdFrames,waitFrames]. Screenshot name, optional save export.

limits: HeartGold UI path tested; SoulSilver script/data/build parity validated separately.
Nickname keyboard acceptance/renaming, loss handling, and complete playthrough remain outside this smoke test. A nonempty pre-starter party is unsupported; start a new game.
No savestates crossed between ROM builds. No user saves were read or modified.
